known_differences.description: fsci-signal implements IIR/FIR design, SOS filtering, spectral analysis (welch, ShortTimeFFT, czt), Savitzky-Golay, and peak finding.

threats.description: High-order transfer-function (BA) IIR filtering suffers polynomial root sensitivity and state overflow.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:9924 (sosfilt): cascades biquad second-order sections with normalized a0 and validates finite section coefficients.
threats.strict_mode_response: Execute direct-form II transposed filtering matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite filter coefficients or signals fail-closed.

threats.description: Non-finite samples or invalid normalized cutoff frequencies (Wn <= 0 or Wn >= 1) passed to filter design or STFT/CZT.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:8029 (butter): validates filter order N >= 1 and cutoff frequencies within (0, 1) Nyquist interval.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(SignalError) on invalid cutoff or order matching SciPy ValueError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite samples and invalid cutoffs fail-closed with FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Degenerate chirp-z transform (CZT) or ZoomFFT parameters (m == 0 or non-finite spiral ratio) causing unbounded work or NaN output.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:12310 (welch): validates segment lengths, overlap bounds, and finite samples before spectral estimation.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(SignalError) on invalid segment/overlap or non-finite CZT parameters.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject degenerate spectral parameters fail-closed and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Peak detection (find_peaks) prominence, width, and plateau conditions drifting from SciPy _peak_finding_utils.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:4132 (find_peaks): evaluates plateau, height, threshold, distance, prominence, and width filters in SciPy's exact order.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy find_peaks indices and properties dictionary.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate distance >= 1 and finite signal samples before peak scan.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: leading denominator coefficient a[0] == 0 in lfilter
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SignalError::ZeroLeadingCoefficient and record FailClosed audit event.
Return SignalError::InvalidCutoff and log FailClosed event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject non-finite inputs in ShortTimeFFT, CZT, and audited routines.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite inputs fail-closed across signal routines.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: noverlap >= nperseg in Welch/CSD spectral estimators
